name: Ishida Toshiaki
source:
A boy assigned to construction site where the story takes place.
He seems to have been brought up well, but is indecisive and naive at times.

When he is pushed around by strong women, will he eventually awaken his sexual talent?!

He has a huge penis that doesn't match his body... !
